pages.text: The next technological advancement you need to concern yourself with is the $(item)Superheated Frames$(). To make them, you will need $(item)Molten Superheated Miasma$() and a few $(item)Singularities$(). It is constructed inside the $(item)Enderium Infusion Basin$().$(br2)The superheated miasma is made from $(l:sim_4/resources/3_fluids)Miasma$() in a refinery that is heated to at least 1901c.

The singularities are constructed using a $(item)Compressor$(). The normal mode of output is that the compressor spits out the item in the world. But when connected to a AE2 Interface, the compressor will automatically output to the interface.
